notes.title: SP3RKLES 3.5 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Sparkles wrecked a spaceship and got kidnapped by a mysterious Green Star, play as Magic in this rescue adventure.


    NEW GAMEPLAY!
    NEW MAGIC!
    NEW FRIENDS!
    NEW CAT!
    NEW BONES!
    NEW GAME!


I was adding gamepad support to the original SS3D, but that didn't work out very well so it turned into this instead. I hope you'll have fun playing!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16202249/c6d8b1999ee790b2fdffa5d98d67126b649a4607.png

notes.title: [SECRET] If you want to try an unfinished version of my 3.5 update! Gamepad needed!
notes.notes:
Hello!
This started as just a small gamepad support update, that quickly got out of hand. It's not really the same game anymore, I think it's better and hopefully more fun.

You can try it by selecting the 3.5 test thing when you launch the game, it's not finished but it's pretty close, just need to make the last boss fight/ending and polish/balance. Planning to get it done before xmas. This works with a 360 style gamepad, I ended up using all buttons except the dpad, might have gone a bit overboard.

Anyway, it would be fun if you played it and left comments so I can fix things. It's late and I'm going to bed but I'll fix bugs in the morning.
Sleep tight Spacemen ːss3dtːːss3dHeart3ː

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16202249/e3479b509610f6db489b839875a86656fbcc41c4.png
